subject: Booth Handoff & Earnback Analysis — WidgetCo ROI Recon
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Richards <tom.richards@widgetco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth leads + immediate recon request

Hi Tom / Samantha,

Thanks again for joining us at FieldWeek — really appreciate WidgetCo staffing the booth and running the demo station. We ran our initial lead export last night and there's a mismatch we need help reconciling before finance closes the month: a cluster of 14 leads captured on the booth iPad show up in our export but were not tagged with the FieldWeek event code in your export, and 6 opportunities in HubSpot that Sales Ops attributes to WidgetCo activity don't have matching lead IDs from your side.

Can you please:
- Share your raw booth export (CSV) with the lead IDs and timestamps (UTM/event_code column preferred)
- Highlight any leads you credited to your reps (name + email)
- Note any post-event list-cleaning you ran (dedupe rules, bounce filtering)

I've attached our booth-leads.csv (redacted) for quick cross-check. We need to agree on an earnback/credit approach for the six disputed opps to finalize the event ROI before Monday's pipeline review.

Proposed next steps: quick 20-min call Monday AM (PDT) to triage and lock credits; Ben, Naomi — please review the attached and flag anything you want on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
Attachments: booth-leads.csv (CSV, 127 rows — redacted)

From: Tom Richards <tom.richards@widgetco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@widgetco.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth leads + immediate recon request

Hi Marissa — thanks for the note and for hosting a great activation. Attaching our export (widgetco_lead_export.csv). Quick notes from our side:

- We used a local form on the booth tablets that creates lead records with field "source=fieldweek_2026". I see a few of the leads in your CSV only have an email and no phone — those were auto-marked as "manual follow-up" in our system and not fully propagated to your HubSpot mapping.
- The six opportunities you mention were created by our AE team after demo follow-ups; they pulled contact info from a separate trade-deck list (Alicia handled those). I can confirm the reps (Alicia M.) did engage within 48h.
- We ran a light dedupe pass on Wednesday that merged duplicates by email only (no fuzzy name match). That likely explains the missing IDs.

If you want, Samantha or I can hop on Monday at 9:30am PDT to walk through the CSV and agree on which opps merit credit.

Tom
Tom Richards | Head of Partnerships, WidgetCo
Attachments: widgetco_lead_export.csv (CSV, 94 rows)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Richards <tom.richards@widgetco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth leads + immediate recon request

Tom — appreciate the quick turnaround and context. Two quick clarifying questions before the call:

1) When you say "merged by email only," can you confirm whether lead IDs changed after merge (i.e., were previous IDs persisted as "merged_from" fields)? We need a stable ID mapping to tie back to the opp in HubSpot.
2) For the six sales-created opps, can you share the initial activity (date/time) that turned them into opportunities — demo record timestamp ideally. If the engagement was within 48h, we can consider full credit per our standard booth-to-demo attribution.

I've started a simple earnback model and attached earnback_calc.xlsx — baseline idea:
- Full credit if demo/contact within 72h of booth capture and initial meeting booked by WidgetCo AE
- Split credit (50/50) if contact >72h but <2 weeks and there was a joint outreach
- No credit if contact came solely from a separate marketing list (trade-deck import) and we can't map to booth capture

On the call, would like to lock the mapping rules and then have Sales Ops push the reconciled lead IDs into a shared HubSpot list so Procurement can close out credits.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: earnback_calc.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tom Richards <tom.richards@widgetco.com>
Date: Sun, 31 May 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booth leads + immediate recon request

Adding the ops lens — I pulled a quick HubSpot fragment and matched by email/timestamp. High-level:
- Of the 14 unmatched leads Marissa flagged, 9 are in HubSpot but with slightly different emails (typos like .con / +alias). Two appear as duplicates that were merged with older accounts (merged IDs listed).
- The six disputed opps: 2 are clearly driven by WidgetCo follow-up (demo booked within 24h, widgetco_rep_id=Alicia.M), 2 look like mixed-source where the initial event contact exists but a trade-deck import overwrote the source, and 2 have no matching booth capture in our export (likely trade-deck-only).

Suggested reconciliation output for the call (we can prep a shared sheet):
- Final list of leads to credit to WidgetCo (include lead_id, email, hubspot_contact_id, opp_id)
- Suggested earnback percentage (Full / Split / None) with rationale
- Timestamped evidence (demo booking email or activity ID)

I'm linking the HubSpot list I'm looking at here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8942 and will create a shared Google Sheet in the folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCxyzEventAssets. Grace — can you confirm Sales Ops can join Monday?

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman | Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turn. Agreed next steps and timeline:

- Monday 9:30am PDT call (30m) — Tom/Samantha, Ben, Naomi, Grace, Marissa. Agenda: reconcile the 14 unmatched leads + agree earnback percentage for the 6 disputed opps.
- By EOD Monday: shared sheet completed with final lead_id -> hubspot_contact_id mapping and earnback outcome. Naomi will own the sheet, Ben will review credits, Tom will confirm WidgetCo rep credits.
- Tuesday morning: Procurement to issue any earnback credit/adjustment so this closes in this MRR cycle.

Please RSVP to the calendar invite I just sent. If we can't get full consensus on Monday, we'll default to the split-credit approach for mixed-source opps and re-open if new evidence surfaces.

Marissa
